plain: Trying to convert others to one's faith or cause

webster.text: The making of converts to a religion or religious sect, or to any opinion, system or party.

more.text: Conversion to a system or creed.

example.quote: There are some reasons which induce us to conclude that the grounds of proselytism extend every w here ; its principles begin to be better understood ; and the inflammatory violence wherewith it was opposed by designing, illiberal, and unthinking minds, begins to subside.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 6, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
